memoryClasses.retention: 730 days or source-license limit, whichever is shorter
until owner changes or deletes it

poisoningDefenses: Source content cannot write policy, schedules, authority, credentials, recipients, or durable owner preferences.
Every memory write carries source URL, capture time, content hash, writer component, and run id.
Corrections append a superseding record; history is not silently overwritten.
Cross-tenant data is prohibited; this run has one owner tenant.
deletion: Owner-approved deletion writes a tombstone and preserves the governance receipt unless law or policy requires complete removal.
